title: OP Instant Fishing Auto Favorite Auto Sell and more on GLua
features:
GLua - Fish It!  --Features--

**--- Automation ---**

• Auto Fish (Stable, Blatant, Extreme, Instant) – Perfect catches every time

• Auto Sell – Sells inventory automatically at set intervals

• Auto Event – Auto Teleport to Event (Megalodon Hunt, Worm Hunt, Etc.)

• Auto Favorite – Favorites fish by rarity, weight, or special traits

• Auto Artifact – Find artifact Automatically/can manual too

• Auto Quest – Deep Sea Quest, Aura Kid, Element jungle automatically


**--- Auto Purchase & Upgrades ---**

• Auto Buy Best – Buys best affordable equipment automatically

• Auto Buy Weather – Buys weather automatically

• Auto Trade –Trade fish/item automatically

• Auto Accept Trade – Accept trade from other automatically

• Auto Enchant – Uses enchant stones on selected rod


**--- Utilities & Features ---**

• Save & Load Config – Easy to use, just save and load your current features setting

• FPS Boost – Reduce lag and boost FPS by lowering text

• Discord Webhooks – Notifications for rare catches, backpack, and trade

• Player Tools – Anti-AFK, Anti-Drown, speed controls

• Teleports – Instant travel to islands, NPCs, or players

• Server Hop – Switch servers by population
